newsitem.title: ITALY: Parmalat falls six percent in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Parmalat falls six percent in Milan.

text.p: Shares in Italy's largest listed food group Parmalat Finanziaria shed around six percent in the afternoon session on talk of a possible bond issue and rumours of weaker than expected results for 1996.
Parmalat shares were trading at 2,530 lire, 5.76 percent down on the day by 1400 GMT, after dipping to 2500 lire per share earlier. Turnover was 8.5 million shares.
"People are talking about a convertible bond issue to finance possible acquisitions maybe in Canada," one broker said.
Another cited talk of lower expectations for 1996 results at the dairy product group.
